routing.title: JARVIS — Routing
routing.description: pick which HA areas are bedrooms (for sleep detection), which media_player group to use for broadcasts, and your phone notify service.

data.bedroom_areas: Bedroom areas (for sleep detection during quiet hours)
data.broadcast_group: Broadcast speaker group (typically your home Cast group)

data_description.bedroom_areas: Any presence sensor in these areas fires sleep mode during quiet hours.
data_description.broadcast_group: Used for critical and high-urgency announcements.
data_description.notify_service: Used when you're away from home or asleep.

observer.title: JARVIS — Observer Mode
observer.description: Configure each Observer model tier and its quiet hours.

identity.title: JARVIS — Identity
identity.description: per-person recognition, so JARVIS tailors itself to who's speaking. Works with no special hardware using presence and (if set up) camera face recognition. Voice fingerprinting is the most accurate but needs a local GPU, so it's off by default.

data.identity_min_confidence: Minimum confidence before committing to a person
data.voice_recognition_source: Voice recognition source (entity from a speaker-recognition service, e.g. binary_sensor.*_voice)
data.voice_recognition_auto_enroll: Auto-flag voices to enroll as people speak

data_description.identity_enabled: Uses who's home + recent camera face recognition. No GPU required.
data_description.identity_voice_fingerprint: Leave off unless you have a GPU server running a voice-ID model.
data_description.identity_min_confidence: Higher = more cautious; stays neutral when unsure.

email.title: JARVIS — Email
email.description: Read-only inbox access. The IMAP password is read from Home Assistant's secrets.yaml — add it there under the key below (default jarvis_imap_password); it is never stored in the panel config.

llm_unavailable.title: JARVIS reasoning backend unavailable
llm_unavailable.description:
JARVIS couldn't reach its reasoning model, so it's running in limited mode — device control, status, and scenes still work. Reason: {detail}

Open the JARVIS panel → Settings and check your provider, model, and API key. If your provider retired the model, re-select it from the list. This notice clears automatically once reasoning is working again.
